$comment: Verbatim transcripts of the RECORDED corpus, produced by whisper.cpp large-v3
on CUDA (RTX 5060 Ti 16GB), greedy, one process per clip, 2026-09-03.
These exist so the R3 zero-false-authorization gate is a TEST, not a
one-off script someone ran once. They are real recogniser output on real
human speech, including its mistakes -- do not hand-correct them. A
transcript that is wrong here is exactly the input the grammar must survive.
Regenerate after a backend or model change and re-run the suite; a new
engine that starts matching a negated utterance is a release blocker.
